name: ramus-mcp
description: Read, see, check, edit and create Ramus IDEF0 models (.rsf) - Claude's eyes and hands for Ramus.
long_description:
Claude opens a Ramus model, reads its activity tree and arrows, and sees each diagram as a picture. It checks the model against the rules of IDEF0 - controls and outputs on every box, ICOM balance between levels, 3 to 6 boxes on a sheet, verbs for activities and nouns for arrows - changes it, with boxes and arrows placed and routed the IDEF0 way, or builds a new model from nothing, and saves a .rsf that Ramus opens. It works on the file format itself: neither Ramus nor Java is needed.

Коннектор, через который Клод читает, рисует, проверяет по правилам IDEF0, правит и создаёт с нуля модели Ramus (.rsf).
